title: JobsCommand
responsibility: Register job lifecycle, backfill, statistics, active status and ETA commands without executing work at registration.

inputs.name: JobsCommand.register.program
inputs.description: Commander root program receiving the jobs family. Subcommand actions execute only after parsing an invocation.

outputs.name: JobsCommand.register
outputs.description: No return value; registers deferred Commander actions or prints the supplied report without changing queue inputs.
